name: TypeDock
postCreateCommand: composer install --no-interaction 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p storage/cache storage/logs storage/sessions storage/tmp storage/uploads storage/backups; if [ ! -f config.php ] && [ -f config.php.example ]; then cp config.php.example config.php; fi; echo 'Ready.
